{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c '
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# R01: put/get with deep copy, tags validation
print("=== R01 Tests ===")
c = TaggedCache(2)

# Deep copy on get
val = {"nested": [1,2,3]}
c.put("a", val, tags=["x"])
result = c.get("a")
result["nested"].append(4)
assert c.get("a")["nested"] == [1,2,3], "Deep copy on get failed"
print("PASS: deep copy on get")

# Deep copy on put
c2 = TaggedCache(2)
val2 = [1,2,3]
c2.put("a", val2)
val2.append(4)
assert c2.get("a") == [1,2,3], "Deep copy on put failed"
print("PASS: deep copy on put")

# Tags deduplication
c3 = TaggedCache(3)
c3.put("a", 1, tags=["x","x","y"])
assert c3.invalidate("x") == 1
assert c3.invalidate("y") == 1
assert len(c3) == 0
print("PASS: tags deduplication")

# Reject bare string as tags
try:
    TaggedCache(2).put("a", 1, tags="bad")
    print("FAIL: bare string accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: bare string rejected")

# Reject nonstring tag entries
try:
    TaggedCache(2).put("a", 1, tags=[1,2])
    print("FAIL: non-string tags accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: non-string tags rejected")

# Invalid input leaves state unchanged
try:
    c3.put("b", 2, tags="bad")
except ValueError:
    pass
assert c3.get("a") == 1
print("PASS: invalid input leaves state unchanged")

# R02: invalidate returns count, replacement removes old tags
print("\n=== R02 Tests ===")
c4 = TaggedCache(3)
c4.put("a", 1, ["old"])
c4.put("a", 2, ["new"])
assert c4.invalidate("old") == 0
assert c4.get("a") == 2
print("PASS: replacement removes old tags")

# R03: maxsize validation
print("\n=== R03 Tests ===")
try:
    TaggedCache(0)
    print("FAIL: zero maxsize accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: zero maxsize rejected")

try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    print("FAIL: negative maxsize accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: negative maxsize rejected")

try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    print("FAIL: bool maxsize accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: bool maxsize rejected")

# Values cost one slot regardless of size
c5 = TaggedCache(2)
c5.put("a", {"big": "data"})
c5.put("b", {"big": "data"})
c5.put("c", {"big": "data"})  # should evict a
assert len(c5) == 2
print("PASS: values cost one slot")

# R04: invalidate_many
print("\n=== R04 Tests ===")
cc = TaggedCache(4)
cc.put("a", 1, ["x"])
cc.put("b", 2, ["x","y"])
cc.put("c", 3, ["y"])
cc.put("d", 4, ["z"])
removed = cc.invalidate_many(["x","z"], mode="any")
assert removed == 2, f"Expected 2, got {removed}"  # a and b
print("PASS: invalidate_many any mode")

cc2 = TaggedCache(3)
cc2.put("a", 1, ["x","y"])
cc2.put("b", 2, ["x"])
cc2.put("c", 3, ["y"])
removed = cc2.invalidate_many(["x","y"], mode="all")
assert removed == 1, f"Expected 1, got {removed}"  # only a
print("PASS: invalidate_many all mode")

# Empty tags removes zero
cc3 = TaggedCache(3)
cc3.put("a", 1, ["x"])
assert cc3.invalidate_many([]) == 0
assert len(cc3) == 1
print("PASS: empty tags removes zero")

# Invalid mode rejected before mutation
try:
    cc3.invalidate_many(["x"], mode="invalid")
    print("FAIL: invalid mode accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: invalid mode rejected")

# R05: resize
print("\n=== R05 Tests ===")
cc4 = TaggedCache(3)
cc4.put("a", 1, ["x"])
cc4.put("b", 2, ["y"])
cc4.put("c", 3, ["z"])
cc4.resize(2)
assert cc4.maxsize == 2
assert len(cc4) == 2
print("PASS: resize down")

cc4.resize(5)
assert cc4.maxsize == 5
assert len(cc4) == 2
print("PASS: resize up")

# Invalid resize preserves state
try:
    cc4.resize(0)
except ValueError:
    pass
assert cc4.maxsize == 5
assert len(cc4) == 2
print("PASS: invalid resize preserves state")

# R06: Tags as generators consumed once
c6 = TaggedCache(3)
c6.put("a", 1, tags=(t for t in ["x","y"]))
assert c6.get("a") == 1
print("PASS: tags as generator")

# R07: TTL
print("\n=== R07 Tests ===")
now = [0]
c7 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: now[0])
c7.put("a", 1, ttl=2)
assert c7.get("a") == 1
now[0] = 2
try:
    c7.get("a")
    print("FAIL: expired key not raised")
except KeyError:
    print("PASS: TTL expiry at boundary")

# TTL=0 immediately expired
c8 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c8.put("a", 1, ttl=0)
assert len(c8) == 0
print("PASS: TTL=0 immediately expired")

# Invalid TTL raises ValueError
try:
    c8.put("a", 1, ttl=-1)
    print("FAIL: negative TTL accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: negative TTL rejected")

try:
    c8.put("a", 1, ttl=True)
    print("FAIL: bool TTL accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: bool TTL rejected")

try:
    c8.put("a", 1, ttl=float("inf"))
    print("FAIL: inf TTL accepted")
except ValueError:
    print("PASS: inf TTL rejected")

# R08: Expired entries removed before operations
print("\n=== R08 Tests ===")
now2 = [0]
c9 = TaggedCache(3, timer=lambda: now2[0])
c9.put("a", 1, ["x"], ttl=1)
c9.put("b", 2, ["y"], ttl=2)
now2[0] = 1
# Only a should be expired
assert len(c9) == 2  # b is still valid
print("PASS: len only counts live entries")

# put also expires
c9.put("c", 3, ["z"], ttl=10)
assert len(c9) == 2  # a expired, b and c remain
print("PASS: put expires old entries")

# invalidate counts only live entries
assert c9.invalidate("x") == 0  # a is already expired
assert c9.invalidate("y") == 1
print("PASS: invalidate counts only live entries")

# Overwriting replaces expiry
c10 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c10.put("a", 1, ttl=10)
now2 = [0]
c10.put("a", 2, ttl=1)  # replace expiry
assert c10.get("a") == 2
print("PASS: overwrite replaces expiry")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS VERIFIED ===")
'
"}
